ov: The largest wild canine in Africa, with a patchy brown, black and white coat. Packs hunt hoofed animals, mostly at dawn and dusk, using stamina and teamwork to run them to exhaustion. It has been listed as endangered since 1990, with an estimated 6,600 adults left.
rg: Sub-Saharan Africa, mostly Southern and East Africa; rare in North Africa.
df: Hoofed animals such as antelopes, wildebeest and kudu calves and zebras, plus hares, cane rats and insects.
fx: Packs have 2 to 27 adults and yearling pups, and members bring up food for other adults as well as for pups.
Pups get to eat first at a kill, a privilege that ends once they are a year old.
